g.text: Reaction equilibrium minimizes Gibbs energy at the allowed reaction extent
Fixed T/P, ideal mixture, one-to-one reaction, initial pure A. Activities are mole fractions for this chosen standard state, Q=x_B/x_A. ΔG°_r/(RT)=−ln4
produces the minimum at x_B=0.8. Extent is constrained by nonnegative species amounts; catalysts change rate, not the equilibrium minimum.
